objective: Task 5: Make telemetry sinks usable and safe — Refactor Recorder and MqttBridge to safely propagate I/O errors and publish typed structured telemetry payloads using shared topic helpers.

acceptance.criterion: Recorder returns io::Result errors instead of panicking on file creation or write errors.
MqttBridge publish_sensors uses shared topic topic_sensors and roundtrips SensorData JSON payload.
MqttBridge publish_fsm_state produces a structured non-empty FsmSnapshot payload on topic_fsm_state instead of {}.
MqttBridge methods publish_sensors, publish_fsm_state, and publish_event return anyhow::Result<()> and route topics via hydragrow_shared::topics without swallowing errors.
MQTT integration tests run deterministically using in-process mock broker without external Mosquitto daemon dependencies.
